text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central<n>plaza during
lunch, I encounter a<n>familiar figure...
Trainer! You seen Flower 'round<n>these parts?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a real tight spot! If I don't find<n>her soon,
then—
Beep, beep!
Hehe, looks like it's my win. Time's<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Lost another one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I looked high and low, but I couldn't<n>track ya
down...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You must be the hide-and-seek<n>champ, Flower!

Th-that's quite the compliment, Taiki.<n>It's nice of
you to say, but I'm a little<n>embarrassed...

You bet we were! My little sisters<n>couldn't get
enough of it back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was the deciding round. And<n>I've got just the
prize for ya,<n>Flower—a big hug for all that good
hidin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, c'mere so I can give ya a<n>squeeze! You've
been such a good<n>girl!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, Taiki! Um... Why don't we go<n>for one more
game since we're<n>already here?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's an idea! Since my<n>trainer's around, why
don't all three<n>of us play together?

You two go and hide! I'll definitely<n>find y'all before
time's up!
Taiki Shuttle runs to a tree and starts<n>counting.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'd better make sure she doesn't<n>find me. Hehe...
Truth is, I haven't lost<n>a single round yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There aren't really any good places<n>to hide, so I
was sure she'd spot me.<n>But as it stands, she
hasn't found me<n>once!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And when I was it, I found her in no<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You know, I just might be really good<n>at
hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I was a little down in the<n>dumps earlier, but
I'm starting to feel<n>better now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My race didn't go as well as I'd<n>hoped... but then
Taiki came to see<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She said, "It only takes a good belly<n>laugh to send
the blues packin'!"

Taiki compliments me every time I<n>hide really well.
When she does, my<n>heart feels all warm and
fuzzy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we should probably hurry and<n>find our hiding
places.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to hide over there. Good<n>luck!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After she finishes counting, Taiki<n>begins her search.
And just one<n>minute later...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... I know you're here<n>somewhere,
Trainer—I can smell ya!<n>Come out, come out,
wherever ya<n>are!
choice_data_list: Stay put and wait it out!

text_block_list.text:
Aha! There ya are, Trainer! Don't<n>think I'm gonna
let ya hightail it!

I try to make a getaway, but with Taiki<n>Shuttle as
my opponent, a successful<n>escape is out of the
question.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I had no idea ya were so speedy,<n>Trainer!
Guess that means I don't<n>need to go easy on ya.
Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So you're playin' the waiting game,<n>are ya? I'm
pretty good at that<n>myself!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is that you I hear rustlin'<n>leaves? I know
you're there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. You gotta wake up pretty<n>early in the
mornin' to escape a<n>sharpshooter like me!
choice_data_list: I can't believe you found me so easily.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're no youngster, so I thought I'd<n>spare the
theatrics I put on for my<n>little sisters!
All right, now to find Flower!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flooower! Where are youuu? I'm<n>gonna find ya
even if it means I gotta<n>run laps 'round the whole
school!

Taiki Shuttle continues her search<n>with a big smile
on her face, all the<n>while pretending not to notice
Nishino<n>Flower's half-hidden tail.
